preconditions.description: Number of vertices and edges within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= di <= 1 for di in d)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value di is within the range [-1, 1].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)

preconditions.description: Number of edges matches the given count.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (isinstance(return_value, list) and len(return_value) == k + 1 and all(isinstance(edge, int) and 1 <= edge <= m for edge in return_value[1:]))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or a list with k+1 elements where the first element is k and the rest are valid edge indices.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(di == -1 or (sum(1 for u, v in edges if u == i or v == i) % 2 == di) for i, di in enumerate(d, start=1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex, if di is -1 or its degree modulo 2 equals di, the subset is good.
